verdict.rationale: Requesty is a hosted LLM gateway, and an open-source license is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has nothing about a public source repository or an open-source license, only hosted service docs, a published OpenAPI spec and llms.txt. A public API spec is a different capability from readable source code, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
